answer: Bonded collateral makes correlated equivocation costly: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting messages, pairwise evidence exposes up to k(k−1)/2 culpable pairs, so slashing scales as O(k²). On detection, an exponential multiplier on capital loss, combined with asymmetric depreciation of seized escrows, makes a sybil swarm increase rather than divide an operator’s risk. Shared evidence links identities like pigment traced through an orchard or sable marks on a ledger.
